notes.title: Quadice 2.0 update!
notes.content:
This update adds many new features and content. 

[list]
[*] 2 new areas.
[*] 3 new characters.
[olist]
[*] Also new costumes! Click on characters multiple times to see if they have costumes.
[/olist]
[*] 3 new songs.
[*] Save features.
[olist]
[*] High Score in Endless Mode. 
[*] Save Volume Levels.
[*] Save Custom Input Mapping.
[/olist]
[*] New 2 Player Win Conditions.
[olist]
[*] First to 2,500/5,000/10,000 Points.
[*] Highest score after 2, 5, 10 minutes.
[/olist]
[*] On-screen pause button.
[/list]

There are also some minor graphical updates and bug fixes, and well as some tweaks to difficulty in Challenge Mode.
